Class Fleet

java.lang.Object
iscteiul.ista.battleship.Fleet
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFleet
public class Fleet extends java.lang.Object implements IFleet
Manages ships on a square board and validates their placement when added. Ships must lie within the board and cannot overlap or touch, even diagonally. The fleet also supports category filtering, position lookup and status output.

    • addShip

      public boolean addShip(IShip s)
      Attempts to add a ship subject to fleet capacity and placement checks. The ship must fit inside the board and must not overlap or touch another ship, including diagonally.

      The capacity check accepts an insertion while the existing number of ships is less than or equal to IFleet.FLEET_SIZE.

      Specified by:
      addShip in interface IFleet
      Parameters:
      s - the non-null ship to add
      Returns:
      true if the ship was added; false if a check failed
